admission.citation: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/models and https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits — Meta Model API documentation, retrieved 2026-09-25: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses at `https://api.meta.ai/v1` with a Model API key; pay-as-you-go per-token billing; serves the Muse Spark models.
